helpers.name: ActorType23_SpawnCollisionResponsePair
helpers.semantics: Converts the source actor in A2 to type 0x84 with animation 0x0012319C and clears actor byte +0x37; if a free slot exists, creates a zero-template actor at the source position, promotes it to type 0x3B with animation 0x00122BD8, then initializes another free actor from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_TYPE_84 and copies the source X/Y words.

helpers.name: Actor_SpawnZeroTemplateAtSourcePosition
helpers.semantics: Loads ACTOR_TEMPLATE_BASE_ZERO through Actor_InitializeFromTemplate and copies source A2 offsets +0x02/+0x04 to destination A5 offsets +0x02/+0x04.

boundary_checks.result: Both exported function bodies terminate at RTS before their neighboring functions; no promoted ranges overlap.

conclusion: The Type-0x23 collision response is now canonicalized as a source conversion plus two conditional companion allocations, with exact template, animation, position-copy, and free-slot failure behavior.
